tasks.label: Test: installer selftest
tasks.detail: finx-install 的 19 项沙箱断言，全程离线，不碰真实目录

tasks.label: Test: perl suite
tasks.detail: t/ 里的 48 个测试文件。make test 会先跑 manifest_check 而它必然失败，所以直接驱动 testmore
tasks.command: make test_setup && cd t && ./testmore.pl && find . -name '*.t' | sort | PREFIX=/opt/finx xargs /usr/bin/perl -I"$(pwd)/../perlmod" -MTest::Harness -e 'runtests(@ARGV)'

tasks.label: Check: shell syntax
tasks.detail: bash -n 覆盖安装器与仓库里的 shell 脚本
tasks.command: for f in finx-install/install.sh finx-install/build-bundle.sh finx-install/selftest.sh finx-install/lib/*.sh install.sh setup.sh mirror/install.sh pre-build-test.sh dpkg-checkall.sh; do bash -n "$f" || { echo "FAILED: $f"; exit 1; }; done && echo 'shell syntax OK'

tasks.label: Check: perl syntax
tasks.detail: perl -c 覆盖全部模块。必须先 test_setup，否则 perlmod/Fink/FinkVersion.pm 还不存在
tasks.command: make test_setup && for f in perlmod/Fink.pm perlmod/Fink/*.pm perlmod/Fink/*/*.pm; do out=$(perl -Iperlmod -c "$f" 2>&1) || { echo "FAILED: $f"; echo "$out"; exit 1; }; done && echo 'perl syntax OK'
